title.zh: 【Drift Protocol 攻击者向 Tornado Cash 转入 1.34 万枚以太坊】
title.en: 【Drift Protocol 攻击者向 Tornado Cash 转入 1.34 万枚以太坊】

current_state.zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者持续通过 Tornado Cash 洗钱，10 月 20 日至 21 日累计存入 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元），相关地址仍持有约 56,569 枚 ETH（约 1.39 亿美元）。
current_state.en: The Drift Protocol attacker continues laundering through Tornado Cash, with cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 reaching 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while the related address still holds about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).

updates.title_zh: 盗取逾2.7亿美元的Drift Protocol漏洞利用者正将ETH转入Tornado Cash
updates.title_en: The Drift Protocol exploiter, who stole over $270M, is moving $ETH to #TornadoCa
updates.what_changed_zh: 攻击者向 Tornado Cash 的转入规模从上一次报告的至少 1.34 万枚 ETH 增至 2.57 万枚 ETH（约 6156 万美元），剩余持仓降至约 8.19 万枚 ETH（约 1.95 亿美元）。
updates.what_changed_en: The attacker's Tornado Cash deposits increased from the previously reported at least 13,400 ETH to 25,700 ETH (~$61.56M), with remaining holdings down to 81,864 ETH (~$195M).
updates.current_state_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者在两个月沉寂后持续洗钱，已向 Tornado Cash 存入 2.57 万枚 ETH（约 6156 万美元），钱包仍持有约 8.19 万枚 ETH（约 1.95 亿美元）。
updates.current_state_en: The Drift Protocol attacker is actively laundering after two months of dormancy, having deposited 25,700 ETH (~$61.56M) into Tornado Cash while still holding 81,864 ETH (~$195M).
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Drift Protocol exploiter deposited 25,700 ETH worth $61.56M into Tornado Cash after two months of inactivity while still holding 81,864 ETH worth $195M.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Drift Protocol exploiter deposited 25,700 ETH worth $61.56M into Tornado Cash after two months of inactivity while still holding 81,864 ETH worth $195M.

updates.title_zh: 【Salus：Drift 黑客再向 Tornado Cash 转入 4600 枚 ETH，约合 1123 万美元】
updates.title_en: 【Salus：Drift 黑客再向 Tornado Cash 转入 4600 枚 ETH，约合 1123 万美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者从另一长期休眠钱包向 Tornado Cash 再存入 4,600 枚 ETH（约 1123 万美元）；其追踪的两个关联钱包累计向 Tornado Cash 存入 30,310 枚 ETH，其中 0xaa8 开头地址累计存入 25,710 枚 ETH。
updates.what_changed_en: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 4,600 ETH (~$11.23M) into Tornado Cash from another previously dormant wallet, bringing the two tracked linked addresses to a combined 30,310 ETH deposited into the mixer; the 0xaa8 address alone accounts for 25,710 ETH.
updates.current_state_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者持续通过 Tornado Cash 洗钱，两个关联钱包已累计存入 30,310 枚 ETH；其中 0xd3f 开头地址新转入 4,600 枚 ETH，监测时仍持有约 20,286 枚 ETH。
updates.current_state_en: The Drift Protocol attacker continues laundering through Tornado Cash, with two linked addresses now having deposited a combined 30,310 ETH; the 0xd3f address newly deposited 4,600 ETH and still held about 20,286 ETH at the time of monitoring.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 4,600 ETH (~$11.23M) into Tornado Cash from a previously dormant wallet, pushing two linked addresses to a combined 30,310 ETH in mixer inflows as laundering of the exploit proceeds continues.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 4,600 ETH (~$11.23M) into Tornado Cash from a previously dormant wallet, pushing two linked addresses to a combined 30,310 ETH in mixer inflows as laundering of the exploit proceeds continues.

updates.title_zh: 【Drift 黑客过去 1 小时再向 Tornado Cash 存入 24,885 枚 ETH，约合 6104 万美元】
updates.title_en: 【Drift 黑客过去 1 小时再向 Tornado Cash 存入 24,885 枚 ETH，约合 6104 万美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者在过去 1 小时内再向 Tornado Cash 存入 24,885 枚 ETH（约 6104 万美元），使其 10 月 20 日至 21 日累计存入量升至 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元），地址仍持有约 56,569 枚 ETH（约 1.39 亿美元）。
updates.what_changed_en: The Drift Protocol attacker deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61.04M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, raising cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while still holding about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
updates.current_state_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者持续通过 Tornado Cash 洗钱，10 月 20 日至 21 日累计存入 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元），相关地址仍持有约 56,569 枚 ETH（约 1.39 亿美元）。
updates.current_state_en: The Drift Protocol attacker continues laundering through Tornado Cash, with cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 reaching 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while the related address still holds about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The attacker behind the April Drift Protocol theft deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, taking cumulative laundering on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M) while still holding roughly 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
updates.detailed_summary_en: The attacker behind the April Drift Protocol theft deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, taking cumulative laundering on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M) while still holding roughly 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
updates.background_zh: Drift 是一家基于 Solana 的去中心化永续合约交易所，其 4 月 1 日遭到的攻击造成损失，安全顾问 Mandiant 将此次攻击归因于一个朝鲜威胁组织。10 月 1 日，该协议开放了 DFX 恢复代币的申领与赎回，使受损用户对一个初始规模约 310 万美元、并获得交易所收入和追回资金的资金池拥有求偿权。Tornado Cash 是一个开源、非托管的混币器，运行于兼容以太坊虚拟机的网络，用于模糊资金来源与目的地地址之间的关联。
updates.background_en: Drift, a Solana-based decentralized perpetual futures exchange, reported losses from the April 1 exploit, which its security consultant Mandiant attributed to a North Korean threat group. On Oct. 1 the protocol opened claims and redemptions for DFX recovery tokens, giving affected users a claim on a pool that launched with about $3.1 million and receives exchange revenue and recovered funds. Tornado Cash is an open-source, non-custodial mixer on Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible networks that obscures the link between source and destination addresses.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要在合规与流动性层面，而非价格层面：大额 ETH 进入混币器会促使交易所、跨链桥和链上分析机构加强对可能与此次黑客事件相关存款的筛查；而仍未动用的 56,569 枚 ETH 则压低了市场对 Drift 的 DFX 求偿池回收规模的预期。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through compliance and liquidity rather than price: large ETH tranches entering a mixer push exchanges, bridges and analytics firms to tighten screening of deposits that may be tied to the hack, while the still-unmoved 56,569 ETH overhang keeps recovery expectations for Drift's DFX claim pool depressed.
